name: Ramp
text: Add a server-side skip link at the top of every page that jumps to the main content. This works without JavaScript and fixes keyboard navigation for users who rely on it. The trade-off is a small extra server request, but it’s worth it for universal access.

name: Reader
text: Ramp’s server-side skip link risks cluttering every page load for sighted users who don’t need it. A better fix is a conditional skip link that only appears after keyboard navigation starts—this keeps the benefit for keyboard users without the constant visual noise. Settle it by testing with screen-reader users: if the skip link appears too late or feels intrusive, drop it; if it’s invisible until needed, keep it.
